license_note: Card name, type line and Oracle text are Wizards of the Coast content; minimal interoperability test object from Scryfall. No images or prices are used.
grist_rule: Legendary planeswalker whose static ability makes it a 1/1 Insect creature as long as it isn't on the battlefield; eligible as a commander but this slice must refuse the zone-dependent class as not_certified.
note: grist-cards.json is an adversarial extension of the real bulk subset using the real API card named Grist; originals under real/ are untouched.
raw_sha256_note: raw_sha256 and cards_sha256 bind the exact embedded raw_cards_jsonl bytes; no unverified full-bulk digest is claimed.
